description: Update job hunt settings and search filters. Use this to change what jobs are matched. config is merged into the saved config: send only the filters you want to change, and every filter you leave out keeps its saved value. To remove a filter, send its empty value: [] for list filters (e.g. "companies": []), null for relevancy, dateOffset, baseSalaryMin and baseSalaryMax, and false for remote and h1bSponsorship. Clearing H1B takes both "workAuthorization": [] and "h1bSponsorship": false. If locations and countries both end up empty, JobGPT falls back to a default country. Use get_job_hunt to see the current config.

autoMode.description: Enable/disable full autopilot mode. When enabled, jobs are automatically matched, scored against your resume using AI, and applied to if they meet your minMatchScore threshold. Resume customization (if enabled) is applied before each application. Each auto-apply consumes a credit.

config.description: Search filter changes. MERGED into the saved config: only the fields you send change, omitted fields keep their saved values. To remove a filter, send its empty value: [] for list filters (e.g. "companies": []), null for relevancy, dateOffset, baseSalaryMin and baseSalaryMax, and false for remote and h1bSponsorship. Clearing H1B takes both "workAuthorization": [] and "h1bSponsorship": false. If locations and countries both end up empty, JobGPT falls back to a default country.

companySize.description: Company sizes (e.g., ["xs" for 1-50, "s" for 50-200, "m" for 200-1K, "l" for 1K-5K, "xl" for 5K+])

dateOffset.description: Only match jobs posted within this time window (e.g., "7D" for last 7 days). Default is "7D".

excludedKeywords.description: Keywords to exclude from job results

excludedTitles.description: Job titles to exclude from results

expLevels.description: Experience levels (e.g., ["SE" for Senior, "MI" for Mid-level, "EN" for Entry])

h1bSponsorship.description: When true, only match jobs that sponsor H1B visas. Same filter as workAuthorization ["h1b"]; either one turns it on.

industries.description: Industries (use get_industries to see valid values)

locations.description: Locations to match. Use plain city names without state abbreviations (e.g., "San Francisco" not "San Francisco, CA"). For states, use the full state name (e.g., "Texas"). Use "Remote" to match remote jobs worldwide without country restrictions.

relevancy.description: Search relevancy mode - HIGH for strict title/skills matching (recommended), MEDIUM for broader keyword-based results. Default is null (MEDIUM behavior).

remote.description: When true, only return remote jobs. When false or omitted, return all jobs (both remote and non-remote).

workArrangement.description: Work arrangement filter (e.g., ["Full Time", "Part Time", "Contract", "Internship", "Freelance", "Temporary"]). Defaults to ["Full Time"] if not set or empty.

workAuthorization.description: Work authorization filters (max 5). "h1b" is the only value that filters today: it only matches jobs that sponsor H1B, the same filter as h1bSponsorship true. Since either field turns the H1B filter on, clearing it takes workAuthorization [] AND h1bSponsorship false.

customizeResume.description: Enable/disable AI resume customization for applications

dailyLimit.description: Maximum jobs to auto-apply per day (max: 100)

minMatchScore.description: Minimum match score for auto-apply (0-1). Default is 0.70 (70%) when not explicitly set.

name.description: New name for the job hunt

name: update_job_hunt
